metadata.status: Provisional financial screen and exposure register; not default probabilities or verified current credit ratings
metadata.macro_selection: Author selection of five present macro transmission channels, informed by dated IATA and IMF research; not an official ranked list. Labour and parts are separate operational overlays.

macro_issues.name: Fuel price and physical availability
macro_issues.mechanism: Jet-fuel prices, refinery/crack spreads and physical availability affect both costs and capacity. Hedges offer dated price protection; they do not assure supply.
macro_issues.monitor: Fuel expense/revenue; hedge horizon and instrument; pricing recovery; physical supply contingency.

macro_issues.name: Conflict, airspace and network disruption
macro_issues.mechanism: Disrupted hubs and airspace can remove revenue, lengthen flights and consume more fuel. Geographic exposure is not financial vulnerability.
macro_issues.monitor: Affected capacity and revenue; rerouting cost; insurance; duration; alternative hubs.

macro_issues.name: Demand, trade and pricing pressure
macro_issues.mechanism: Real-income pressure and trade friction can weaken passenger demand or cargo flows. Premium, leisure and cargo businesses respond differently.
macro_issues.monitor: Forward bookings, yields, load factor, cargo contribution and unit revenue against unit cost.

macro_issues.name: Interest rates and refinancing access
macro_issues.mechanism: Inflation and market volatility can raise funding costs or constrain credit. Maturity timing and collateral determine who needs to refinance into that market.
macro_issues.monitor: Cash interest, floating debt, next 24-month maturities, covenants and committed available facilities.

macro_issues.name: Currency mismatch and dollar-linked costs
macro_issues.mechanism: Dollar-linked fuel, aircraft and debt can create a mismatch with local-currency receipts. Reporting currency alone cannot establish its size or direction.
macro_issues.monitor: Net cash exposure by currency, matching revenues/debt, hedges and currency sensitivity.
